summary: Silicon Valley resident, software engineer with over 25 years of experience, B.S. in Mathematics, independent consultant, strong advocate for open-source software, user of Mutt and Emacs, bilingual (Finnish and French), father of a multilingual child, critic of modern hiring practices in tech, nostalgic for 90s tech culture, prefers small, simple technology (e.g., Motorola Razr), critical of Agile methodology, believes in decentralization of internet services, has lived through Hurricane Maria in Puerto Rico, values long-term software support, and has a strong interest in email infrastructure and self-hosting.
